EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Write the instructions your team wants every project to start from. Saving creates a draft; publishing changes the live shared guidance.
PROJECT_EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Add project-specific instructions. Choose whether they supplement the shared layer or explicitly override it.
EDITOR_PLACEHOLDER: Describe the product context, voice, constraints, and decisions your team wants to keep consistent.
REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Previous revisions are preserved. Restore one from history before publishing it again.
PROJECT_REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Previous project revisions are preserved. Restore one from history before publishing it again.
PROJECT_MODE_HELP: Choose supplement to add to shared guidance, or override when this project must use only its own instructions.
NO_REVISION_YET: No revision has been created yet.
EFFECTIVE_DESCRIPTION: Review the instructions that are active for this workspace or for one project. Project guidance can supplement or override the shared layer.
EFFECTIVE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Save and publish shared guidance to make it available to work in this workspace.
CONFLICT_OVERRIDE_DESCRIPTION: The selected project is using its own guidance instead of the shared instructions.
UNAVAILABLE_UNPUBLISHED_DESCRIPTION: Draft guidance is not included in the effective context until it is published.
UNAVAILABLE_REMOVED_DESCRIPTION: Restore a prior revision if this guidance should be used again.
PROJECTS_LOAD_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The workspace preview remains available. Retry to choose a project context.
HISTORY_DESCRIPTION: Every saved and published version is kept here. Restoring creates a new draft and never rewrites an earlier revision.
HISTORY_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: The first saved draft will appear here.
RESTORE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Restoring creates a new draft from this revision. It does not publish the revision automatically.
PROJECT_RESTORE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Restoring creates a new project draft from this revision. It does not publish the revision automatically.
REMOVE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Removing shared guidance makes it unavailable to future work. Existing revision history is retained.
PROJECT_REMOVE_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Removing project guidance makes it unavailable to future work in this project. Existing revision history is retained.
PREVIEW_STALE_TITLE: This preview is no longer current
PREVIEW_STALE_DESCRIPTION: Review the latest guidance state and create a new preview before applying this change.
APPLY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: Nothing was changed. Review the current guidance state and try again.
REFERENCES_DESCRIPTION: Attach existing knowledge collections when their material should support this guidance. Attaching a reference does not replace the shared instructions.
OPERATION_FAILED_TITLE: Guidance action could not be completed
OPERATION_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: Nothing was assumed to have changed. Review the current state and try the action again.
PROJECT_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Manage instructions that apply only to this project and review their effective context.
PROJECT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED_TITLE: Choose a workspace to manage project guidance
PROJECT_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION: Project guidance is scoped to the active workspace. Select the project from an available workspace and try again.
REFERENCES_DIRECTORY_DESCRIPTION: Create and maintain source material that can support shared or project guidance.
REFERENCE_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Group source material that the workspace can later attach to its guidance.
REFERENCE_NAME_HELP: Use a clear name that helps collaborators recognize this material.
REFERENCE_DIRECTORY_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create a collection when your team has source material worth reusing.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Add a manual page or a website that this collection can maintain.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_URL_HELP: Use a public HTTP or HTTPS address that the workspace is allowed to process.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_KEY_HELP: Optional internal label for organizing this manual page.
REFERENCE_SOURCE_EMPTY: No sources have been added to this collection.
REFERENCE_FRESHNESS_STALE: Last successful version is still in use
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The last processing attempt did not complete. Existing ready material, if any, remains unchanged.
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: Processing is not currently available for this source.
REFERENCE_VERSION_CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Save the next immutable version of this manual source. It will be processed before it becomes available for use.
REFERENCE_VERSION_CONTENT_HELP: Use the complete source text you want the workspace to process.
REFERENCE_CAPABILITIES_FAILED_TITLE: Reference capabilities could not be loaded
REFERENCE_CAPABILITIES_FAILED_DESCRIPTIO: No availability was assumed. Retry to see which source types this workspace can use.
REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL_UNAVAILABLE_DESCRIPT: Sources can be prepared, but the workspace cannot yet run a retrieval test or show citations from it.
